_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Qanri p'ukllayuq {player_id} kimsa p'ukllayuq Tic Tac Toe pi.
Qan symbolayki '{symbol}'.
Qan turnaykikunawan symbolaykita p'ankallapi 5x5 nisqapi, t'inkunata ruwanapaq.
T'inkunakunaqa waqaychay, khillaychay, icha diagonalninqa.
Ruraykita '[4]' formatupi apaykachay, khillay 4 mark'aypaq.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mana allin rura formatu. '[cell]' taytanchik, khillay 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Pichu {player_id} pukllaq mana allin puriyta ruwarqan.
